'''Kera Haellin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. 

== Appearance ==
Kera has the blue eyes and fair hair that appeared occasionally among Tairens. She has an arrogant demeanor common to Greens.

== History ==
She is of [[Tairen]] noble birth.{{ref|{{twotc}}|Kera Haellin}}

She is almost certainly a relative of High Lord [[Sunamon Haellin]], although we do not know how distant a relative. She may be anything from a sister to a branch of the family that existed 200 years before the start of the books.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split. When [[Alviarin Freidhen]] was leaving [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]'s quarters and going to her own, she passed Kera in the halls of the [[White Tower|Tower]].{{ref/book|7|p}} Kera curtsies to Alviarin in orded to curry favor with her, despite it not being required. Kera did not like it, but she thought Alviarin might provide some protection from Elaida's unpredictability.
